files.excerpt: ## `CAST` ```zetasql CAST(expression AS typename [format_clause]) ``` **Description** Cast syntax is used in a query to indicate that the result type of an expression should be converted to some other type. When using `CAST`, a query can fail if ZetaSQL is unable to perform the cast. If you want to protect your queries from these types of errors, you can use [SAFE_CAST][con-func-safecast].
